items.title: Mitchel McAllister Interview, 1960-03-19
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Did you ever hear Erskine Tate up there? No. No. No. [INTERVIEWEE] No, sir.

ctx.x: What was that one time? What was that? What was that? We were just talking about that in here the other day. Just last week, Tom and I was trying to... Was thinking about that same thing. We left with Mr. Peabody, I think from... From West Baden, Indiana. And... We gone over there. Let me see, I don't know. I just remember now who was playing that dance at night.
Did you ever hear Erskine Tate up there? No. No. No.
